payload.summary:
While at anchor, the ship was boarded by the perpetrators.
Some brass items such as fire hose coupling, nozzles,
cargo light wires, ship’s bell and butterfly nuts inside the
Bosun Store were stolen. The crew were not injured.
The incident was reported to the National Search and
Rescue Agency of the coastal States.
